title: God's Temple and the World's Wisdom
description: Paul reminds the Corinthians that they are God's holy temple where the Spirit lives, and warns against destroying the temple. He says that the world's wisdom is foolishness for God, and that no one should boast about human leaders, for all things belong to them, and they belong to Christ. [ref:1 Cor 3:16-23|1 Corinthians 3:16-23]
